definition: to open your mouth wide and breathe in because you are tired or bored
sentence: The lecture made half the room {yawn}.
translation: От лекции полкомнаты зевало.

definition: to pay back money that someone has spent for you
sentence: The company will {reimburse} your travel expenses within a month.
translation: Компания возместит ваши дорожные расходы в течение месяца.

definition: something done only because the rules require it, or polite formal behavior
sentence: The interview was a {formality}; the job was already hers.
translation: Собеседование было формальностью, работа уже была её.

definition: a person believed to have the power to speak to spirits and heal people
sentence: The {shaman} beat a drum and sang to cure the sick child.
translation: Шаман бил в бубен и пел, чтобы вылечить больного ребёнка.

definition: an unusual habit or feature that makes someone or something different
sentence: One {quirk} of the house is that the stairs lead nowhere.
translation: Одна странность дома в том, что лестница ведёт в никуда.

definition: a flat that you own in a building of flats owned by different people
sentence: They bought a {condominium} with a view of the bay.
translation: Они купили кондоминиум с видом на залив.

definition: a small glass bottle for medicine or liquids
sentence: The nurse filled the needle from a tiny {vial}.
translation: Медсестра наполнила иглу из крошечного флакона.

definition: to leave someone or something for ever, especially when they need you
sentence: He would never {forsake} his friends in a time of trouble.
translation: Он никогда не бросил бы друзей в трудную минуту.

definition: a person who tells the public or the authorities about wrongdoing in their organization
sentence: The {whistleblower} lost her job after reporting the fraud.
translation: Информатор потеряла работу после того, как сообщила о мошенничестве.

definition: a flat wooden base on which goods are stacked for moving by machine
sentence: The forklift lifted a {pallet} of bricks onto the truck.
translation: Погрузчик поднял поддон с кирпичами на грузовик.

definition: to speak angrily to someone, especially a child, because they did something wrong
sentence: Mother will {scold} us if we come home muddy again.
translation: Мама отругает нас, если мы снова придём домой грязными.

definition: to gather closely together, often because of cold or fear
sentence: The sheep {huddle} together under the tree when it rains.
translation: Овцы сбиваются в кучу под деревом, когда идёт дождь.

definition: to force liquid out in a thin fast stream
sentence: The kids {squirt} each other with water guns all summer.
translation: Дети всё лето брызгают друг в друга из водяных пистолетов.

definition: a person who owns or works on a large farm for cattle or horses
sentence: The {rancher} rides out every morning to check the cattle.
translation: Владелец ранчо каждое утро выезжает проверить скот.

definition: a large wild cat with spots that can run faster than any other animal
sentence: A {cheetah} can reach a hundred kilometers an hour in seconds.
translation: Гепард может разогнаться до ста километров в час за секунды.

definition: to make a short, low sound, like a pig or a person lifting something heavy
sentence: He would only {grunt} when I asked about his day.
translation: Он лишь хмыкал, когда я спрашивал, как прошёл его день.

definition: a way of raising money in which people buy numbered tickets and win prizes
sentence: She won a bicycle in the school {raffle}.
translation: Она выиграла велосипед в школьной лотерее.

definition: a person who tricks people out of money, often online or by phone
sentence: The {scammer} pretended to be from her bank and asked for her password.
translation: Мошенник притворился сотрудником её банка и попросил пароль.

definition: from or at a great distance
sentence: Visitors came from {afar} to see the eclipse.
translation: Посетители приехали издалека, чтобы увидеть затмение.

definition: showing love or fondness for someone
sentence: The {affectionate} dog licked everyone who came in.
translation: Ласковая собака облизывала каждого, кто входил.

definition: to make someone anxious or angry, or to argue publicly for change
sentence: Loud noises {agitate} the horses before a race.
translation: Громкие звуки беспокоят лошадей перед скачками.

definition: the process of proving that a user or object is what it claims to be
sentence: Two-step {authentication} protects your account with a code sent to your phone.
translation: Двухэтапная аутентификация защищает аккаунт кодом, отправленным на телефон.

definition: a bright blue color like the sky on a clear day
sentence: The boat sailed across the {azure} of the bay.
translation: Лодка плыла по лазури залива.

definition: the area next to a bed
sentence: The doctor stood at the {bedside} and checked the chart.
translation: Врач стоял у постели и проверял карту.

definition: to surround a town with an army, or to crowd around someone with demands
sentence: Fans would {besiege} the hotel every time the band came to town.
translation: Фанаты осаждали отель каждый раз, когда группа приезжала в город.

definition: a hat tied under the chin, worn by babies or women in the past
sentence: The baby wore a white {bonnet} against the sun.
translation: На ребёнке был белый чепчик от солнца.

definition: a fish with long feelers around its mouth that lives at the bottom of rivers
sentence: We caught a huge {catfish} in the muddy river.
translation: Мы поймали огромного сома в мутной реке.

definition: relating to office work, or to priests
sentence: She did {clerical} work at the bank for ten years.
translation: Она десять лет занималась канцелярской работой в банке.

definition: a picture made by sticking pieces of paper, cloth or photos onto a surface
sentence: The children made a {collage} of autumn leaves and magazine pictures.
translation: Дети сделали коллаж из осенних листьев и картинок из журналов.

definition: a person who settles in a new country or area as part of a colony
sentence: The first {colonist} in the valley built a house of logs.
translation: Первый колонист в долине построил дом из брёвен.

definition: given free of charge, or expressing praise
sentence: The hotel offers a {complimentary} breakfast to every guest.
translation: Отель предлагает каждому гостю бесплатный завтрак.

definition: an opinion based on incomplete information; a guess
sentence: The cause of the fire is still a matter of {conjecture}.
translation: Причина пожара по-прежнему остаётся предметом догадок.

definition: very easy to see or notice
sentence: The red car was {conspicuous} among the grey ones in the car park.
translation: Красная машина бросалась в глаза среди серых на парковке.

definition: happening again and again, often in an annoying way
sentence: The {continual} noise from the road made sleep impossible.
translation: Непрерывный шум с дороги делал сон невозможным.

definition: strong action by the authorities to stop illegal or unwanted behavior
sentence: The police began a {crackdown} on drunk driving before the holidays.
translation: Полиция начала жёсткие меры против пьяного вождения перед праздниками.

definition: a shop or counter selling cold meats, cheeses and prepared food
sentence: I bought smoked salmon and olives at the {deli} on the corner.
translation: Я купил копчёного лосося и оливки в кулинарии на углу.

definition: the hard white outer layer of a tooth, or a shiny paint-like coating
sentence: Sugary drinks slowly destroy the {enamel} on your teeth.
translation: Сладкие напитки медленно разрушают эмаль на зубах.

definition: extremely; to a very great degree
sentence: The test was {exceedingly} difficult, even for the top students.
translation: Тест был чрезвычайно трудным даже для лучших студентов.

definition: more than is necessary or reasonable
sentence: He was {excessively} polite, apologizing for every small thing.
translation: Он был чрезмерно вежлив, извиняясь за каждую мелочь.

definition: land used for growing crops or keeping animals
sentence: The new road will cut through rich {farmland}.
translation: Новая дорога пройдёт через плодородные сельскохозяйственные земли.

definition: in a very strong, angry or determined way
sentence: The two shops compete {fiercely} for the same customers.
translation: Два магазина яростно конкурируют за одних и тех же покупателей.

definition: coming after thirteen others in order
sentence: The {fourteenth} floor is really the thirteenth in that hotel.
translation: Четырнадцатый этаж в этом отеле на самом деле тринадцатый.

definition: the study of family history and the line of ancestors
sentence: Her interest in {genealogy} led her to a cousin in Canada.
translation: Интерес к генеалогии привёл её к кузену в Канаде.

definition: in terms of where places are on the Earth
sentence: The two villages are {geographically} close but have different dialects.
translation: Две деревни географически близки, но говорят на разных диалектах.

definition: special glasses that protect the eyes from water, wind or chemicals
sentence: Wear {goggles} when you use the grinder.
translation: Надевай защитные очки, когда работаешь с шлифовальной машиной.

definition: relating to grammar, or following the rules of grammar
sentence: The essay had several {grammatical} errors in the first paragraph.
translation: В первом абзаце эссе было несколько грамматических ошибок.

definition: a soft black form of carbon used in pencils and as a lubricant
sentence: The pencil's dark line is made of {graphite}, not lead.
translation: Тёмная линия карандаша сделана из графита, а не свинца.

definition: a belief that goes against the official teaching of a religion or group
sentence: In the Middle Ages, people were burned for {heresy}.
translation: В Средние века людей сжигали за ересь.

definition: a viral disease that causes painful spots on the skin, often around the mouth
sentence: Cold sores on the lips are caused by the {herpes} virus.
translation: Простуда на губах вызывается вирусом герпеса.

definition: a young person who follows the latest fashions outside the mainstream
sentence: The cafe is full of one {hipster} after another with a laptop.
translation: Кафе полно хипстеров с ноутбуками.

definition: a woman who welcomes guests at a party, restaurant or on a plane
sentence: The {hostess} showed us to a table by the window.
translation: Хостес проводила нас к столику у окна.

definition: a very large piece of ice floating in the sea
sentence: The ship hit an {iceberg} and sank in three hours.
translation: Корабль столкнулся с айсбергом и затонул за три часа.

definition: light, or the act of lighting something up
sentence: The {illumination} of the bridge at night attracts tourists.
translation: Подсветка моста ночью привлекает туристов.

definition: to make a person or place poor
sentence: Years of war served to {impoverish} the whole region.
translation: Годы войны обнищили весь регион.

definition: in a way that is wrong, dishonest or not suitable
sentence: The report says the money was {improperly} spent on gifts.
translation: В отчёте говорится, что деньги были неправомерно потрачены на подарки.

definition: very clever and original, used of ideas, inventions or people
sentence: She found an {ingenious} way to open the lock with a hairpin.
translation: Она нашла остроумный способ открыть замок шпилькой.

definition: a long, hard series of questions, like a trial
sentence: Coming home late meant facing an {inquisition} from my parents.
translation: Прийти домой поздно означало выдержать допрос родителей.

definition: the stone or brick parts of a building, or the work of building with them
sentence: The old {masonry} of the church needs repair after the earthquake.
translation: Старая каменная кладка церкви нуждается в ремонте после землетрясения.

definition: by machine, or without thinking, like a machine
sentence: She answered the questions {mechanically}, thinking of something else.
translation: Она отвечала на вопросы механически, думая о другом.

definition: containing or covered with oil, or too polite in a way that is not sincere
sentence: His hair looked {oily} after three days without washing.
translation: После трёх дней без мытья его волосы выглядели сальными.

definition: according to what seems or is said to be true, but perhaps not
sentence: He called {ostensibly} to ask about work, but really to borrow money.
translation: Он позвонил якобы спросить о работе, а на самом деле занять денег.

definition: saying what you think openly, even if it shocks or offends people
sentence: She is an {outspoken} critic of the new tax.
translation: Она открыто критикует новый налог.

definition: the top part of the inside of the mouth, or a person's sense of taste
sentence: The hot soup burned the roof of my {palate}.
translation: Горячий суп обжёг мне нёбо.

definition: a base on which a statue or column stands
sentence: The statue was lifted onto a marble {pedestal}.
translation: Статую подняли на мраморный пьедестал.

definition: the record of an animal's parents and ancestors, or a person's background
sentence: The puppy has a {pedigree} going back ten generations.
translation: У щенка родословная, уходящая на десять поколений назад.

definition: not real or sincere; false
sentence: He gave the police a {phony} name and address.
translation: Он назвал полиции фальшивое имя и адрес.

definition: to find or say exactly where or what something is
sentence: Doctors could not {pinpoint} the cause of her headaches.
translation: Врачи не могли точно определить причину её головных болей.

definition: in an enjoyable, friendly or agreeable way
sentence: I was {pleasantly} surprised by how cheap the hotel was.
translation: Я был приятно удивлён тем, как дёшев был отель.

definition: great skill or ability at something, especially sport or fighting
sentence: His {prowess} on the football field won him a scholarship.
translation: Его мастерство на футбольном поле принесло ему стипендию.

definition: in a way that relates to the mind and how it affects behavior
sentence: The long trial was {psychologically} exhausting for the witnesses.
translation: Долгий процесс был психологически изнурительным для свидетелей.

definition: money paid back to someone for costs they have paid
sentence: Keep the receipts if you want {reimbursement} for the taxi.
translation: Сохрани чеки, если хочешь возмещения за такси.

definition: to feel sorry for something bad you did and decide not to do it again
sentence: The thief said he would {repent} and start a new life.
translation: Вор сказал, что раскается и начнёт новую жизнь.

definition: the liquid produced in the mouth that helps you swallow food
sentence: The smell of fresh bread filled my mouth with {saliva}.
translation: От запаха свежего хлеба у меня потекли слюнки.

definition: having no purpose or meaning, or unconscious
sentence: It was a {senseless} crime; nothing was even stolen.
translation: Это было бессмысленное преступление, даже ничего не украли.

definition: coming after sixteen others in order
sentence: The castle was built in the {seventeenth} century.
translation: Замок был построен в семнадцатом веке.

definition: the moment when an aircraft leaves the ground
sentence: Please fasten your seat belts for {takeoff}.
translation: Пожалуйста, пристегните ремни перед взлётом.

definition: on which tax must be paid
sentence: Interest from a savings account is {taxable} income.
translation: Проценты по сберегательному счёту — налогооблагаемый доход.

definition: an exercise machine with a moving belt that you walk or run on
sentence: I run five kilometers on the {treadmill} every morning.
translation: Я каждое утро пробегаю пять километров на беговой дорожке.

definition: impossible to prevent or avoid
sentence: Some delay is {unavoidable} when the trains are this full.
translation: Некоторая задержка неизбежна, когда поезда так переполнены.

definition: done by one side only, without agreement from the others
sentence: The company made a {unilateral} decision to cut wages.
translation: Компания в одностороннем порядке решила урезать зарплаты.

definition: a large round fruit with green skin, red flesh and black seeds
sentence: We ate cold {watermelon} on the beach after swimming.
translation: Мы ели холодный арбуз на пляже после купания.

definition: towards the west
sentence: The wagons rolled {westward} across the plains for months.
translation: Фургоны месяцами катились на запад через равнины.

definition: to shine or burn in an unsteady way, going on and off quickly
sentence: The candle began to {flicker} in the draft from the door.
translation: Свеча замерцала на сквозняке от двери.

definition: a person who behaves in a wild, dangerous or crazy way
sentence: He drives like a {maniac} on the mountain roads.
translation: Он гоняет по горным дорогам как безумец.

definition: a wall or barrier built quickly to block a street or entrance
sentence: Protesters built a {barricade} of cars and furniture across the road.
translation: Протестующие построили баррикаду из машин и мебели поперёк дороги.

definition: one of the main beliefs or principles of a religion or theory
sentence: Equality before the law is a basic {tenet} of democracy.
translation: Равенство перед законом — базовый принцип демократии.

definition: a small increase in a number or amount, often one of a regular series
sentence: Your salary rises by a fixed {increment} every year.
translation: Ваша зарплата растёт на фиксированную прибавку каждый год.

definition: a person who takes control of a country or people by force
sentence: The {conqueror} built a castle on the hill above the town.
translation: Завоеватель построил замок на холме над городом.

definition: a false idea or belief, especially one that many people think is true
sentence: It is a {fallacy} that we only use ten percent of our brain.
translation: То, что мы используем лишь десять процентов мозга, — заблуждение.

definition: to change chemically through the action of yeast or bacteria, as in making wine
sentence: Grape juice will {ferment} into wine in a few weeks.
translation: Виноградный сок за несколько недель перебродит в вино.

definition: a small worm that lives in water and sucks blood from animals and people
sentence: A {leech} attached itself to his leg in the pond.
translation: В пруду к его ноге присосалась пиявка.

definition: a person who receives a pension, usually because they are old
sentence: The {pensioner} lives alone on a small income.
translation: Пенсионер живёт один на небольшой доход.

definition: a chemical made of hydrogen and carbon, such as oil or gas
sentence: Burning any {hydrocarbon} releases carbon dioxide.
translation: Сжигание любого углеводорода выделяет углекислый газ.

definition: to let saliva run out of your mouth, or to show great desire for something
sentence: Big dogs {drool} when they see their dinner.
translation: Большие собаки пускают слюни, когда видят свой ужин.

definition: to wake someone up, or to make someone feel strong emotion
sentence: The speech helped {rouse} the tired crowd to cheer again.
translation: Речь помогла расшевелить уставшую толпу, и она снова ликовала.

definition: one of the small bones that form the spine
sentence: The accident cracked a {vertebra} in his lower back.
translation: В аварии у него треснул позвонок в пояснице.

definition: a small boat kept on a ship to save people if the ship sinks
sentence: Every passenger has a place in a {lifeboat}.
translation: У каждого пассажира есть место в спасательной шлюпке.

definition: a bean rich in protein, used to make oil, milk and tofu
sentence: Tofu is made from the {soybean}, not from milk.
translation: Тофу делают из соевых бобов, а не из молока.

definition: an official in a government department, especially one who follows rules too strictly
sentence: Some {bureaucrat} lost my form and I had to start again.
translation: Какой-то чиновник потерял мою форму, и мне пришлось начать заново.

definition: a building with large blades that the wind turns to grind grain
sentence: The old {windmill} still grinds flour on windy days.
translation: Старая ветряная мельница до сих пор мелет муку в ветреные дни.

definition: to join metal parts by melting a soft metal between them
sentence: You need to {solder} the wire to the board carefully.
translation: Нужно аккуратно припаять провод к плате.

definition: a person who introduces new ideas, methods or products
sentence: The company was founded by an {innovator} in battery design.
translation: Компанию основал новатор в области аккумуляторов.

definition: a warm, soft top with long sleeves that you pull over your head
sentence: He pulled on a grey {sweatshirt} and went for a run.
translation: Он натянул серую толстовку и пошёл на пробежку.

definition: to take back a statement you made, or to pull something back in
sentence: The newspaper had to {retract} its story about the minister.
translation: Газете пришлось отозвать статью о министре.

definition: to increase gradually over time, used of money or benefits
sentence: Interest will {accrue} on the loan from the first day.
translation: Проценты по займу будут начисляться с первого дня.

definition: to switch something off or make it stop working
sentence: You can {deactivate} your account without deleting your photos.
translation: Вы можете деактивировать аккаунт, не удаляя фотографии.

definition: to shine softly with reflected light
sentence: The wet rocks {gleam} in the morning sun.
translation: Мокрые камни блестят на утреннем солнце.

definition: a military leader who controls an area by force, outside the official government
sentence: The {warlord} ruled the valley with his private army.
translation: Полевой командир правил долиной с помощью своей армии.

definition: one of the two male organs that produce sperm
sentence: Doctors found a lump on the left {testicle} early enough to treat it.
translation: Врачи вовремя обнаружили уплотнение на левом яичке, чтобы его вылечить.

definition: to think that someone or something is bad or wrong
sentence: Her parents {disapprove} of her new boyfriend.
translation: Её родители не одобряют её нового парня.

definition: to claim something, often falsely, or to state a belief openly
sentence: They {profess} to love animals but keep the dog chained outside.
translation: Они заявляют, что любят животных, но держат собаку на цепи во дворе.

definition: with a taste like a lemon, or containing acid
sentence: Lemons are too {acidic} to eat on their own.
translation: Лимоны слишком кислые, чтобы есть их просто так.

definition: the act of following a rule, belief or plan closely
sentence: Strict {adherence} to the recipe gives the best bread.
translation: Строгое следование рецепту даёт лучший хлеб.

definition: to stop a meeting or trial for a time, planning to continue later
sentence: The judge decided to {adjourn} the trial until Monday.
translation: Судья решил отложить процесс до понедельника.

definition: a medical condition in which a person cannot remember things
sentence: After the crash he suffered from {amnesia} and did not know his name.
translation: После аварии он страдал амнезией и не знал своего имени.

definition: in an angry way
sentence: She slammed the door {angrily} and left.
translation: Она сердито хлопнула дверью и ушла.

definition: relating to courts that hear appeals against decisions of lower courts
sentence: The {appellate} court overturned the original sentence.
translation: Апелляционный суд отменил первоначальный приговор.

definition: only just, almost not
sentence: I had {scarcely} sat down when the phone rang.
translation: Едва я сел, как зазвонил телефон.

definition: to keep saying in a low voice that you are not happy about something
sentence: He {grumbled} about the price the whole way home.
translation: Он всю дорогу домой ворчал насчёт цены.
